# doit_cloudconnect_gcp_requirements (Data Source)

Resolves what to set up in Google Cloud before registering a `doit_cloudconnect_gcp_connection`: the service account DoiT impersonates, the IAM permissions of each feature, setup artifacts and the current feature catalog version. The read changes nothing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "doit_cloudconnect_gcp_requirements" "project" {
  scope_kind  = "gcp_project"
  project_id  = "example-project"
  feature_ids = ["core", "bigquery-finops"]

  feature_inputs = {
    bigquery_finops = {
      location = "EU"
    }
  }
}

# The permissions each feature needs on the project
output "feature_permissions" {
  value = data.doit_cloudconnect_gcp_requirements.project.features
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope_kind` (String) Google Cloud resource to connect: `gcp_organization`, `gcp_project` or `gcp_dataset`.

### Optional

- `dataset_id` (String) BigQuery dataset ID, when `scope_kind` is `gcp_dataset`.
- `feature_ids` (Set of String) Features to evaluate. Omit it to list every feature available for the scope.
- `feature_inputs` (Attributes) Inputs of features that need them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--feature_inputs))
- `identity_inputs` (Attributes) Where to place the service account DoiT impersonates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--identity_inputs))
- `organization_id` (String) Numeric Google Cloud organization ID, when `scope_kind` is `gcp_organization`.
- `project_id` (String) Google Cloud project ID, when `scope_kind` is `gcp_project` or `gcp_dataset`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `artifacts` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--artifacts))
- `catalog_version` (String)
- `features` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--features))
- `follow_ups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--follow_ups))
- `identity` (Attributes) Resolved identity details required to grant Cloud Connect access. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--identity))
- `preconditions` (Attributes) Precondition evaluation summary for the target scope. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--preconditions))

<a id="nestedatt--feature_inputs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `feature_inputs`

Optional:

- `bigquery_finops` (Attributes) Inputs of the `bigquery-finops` feature. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--feature_inputs--bigquery_finops))

<a id="nestedatt--feature_inputs--bigquery_finops"></a>
### Nested Schema for `feature_inputs.bigquery_finops`

Optional:

- `location` (String) BigQuery location of the FinOps log-sink dataset. The API defaults it to `US`.



<a id="nestedatt--identity_inputs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `identity_inputs`

Optional:

- `project_id` (String) Project that hosts the service account. Required when `scope_kind` is `gcp_organization`.
- `role_id` (String) ID of the custom IAM role to create.
- `service_account_id` (String) Account ID of the service account (the part of the email before `@`). Required when `scope_kind` is `gcp_dataset`.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
